run_f_gold: run f_gold to sort an array of N values containing 1 to N in-place
test_f_gold: test f_gold with arrays of varying sizes to verify correct 1-to-N sorting
review_f_gold: review f_gold which overwrites the first N elements of an array with values 1 through N
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use a more efficient in-place sorting algorithm for arrays with values 1 to N
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold a function that sorts an array containing values 1 to N by sequential assignment
